name: io.github.srpp011/dailymeteo-mcp
title: DailyMeteo
description: Historical weather and climate normals for any land location, 1 km grids, 1961 to today

environmentVariables.name: DAILYMETEO_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: DailyMeteo account email; enables daily data, credits, point history and area downloads

environmentVariables.name: DAILYMETEO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Alternative to the account, for daily point data only

environmentVariables.name: DAILYMETEO_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Folder for CSV files and downloads (default ~/dailymeteo)
